notes.title: Patch 1.2 now available
notes.notes:
Added full pad support! It's not as nice as keyboard and mouse, but does mean you can play on your sofa.
Fixed an exploit where you can repeatedly connect 2 cities together for more connection bandwidth
Added a large number of extra tooltips to help players understand the game


This is all in preparation for the Switch release of the game, which I'm excited about. Any issues, changes or things you think should happen before it goes to a new platform? Let me know on the forum!
